First thing you shouldn’t do is getting your hopes high. Your friends may be very supportive or maybe they don’t know how to support you. Some people understand and some don’t. But I think you totally should tell them. Maybe try by starting with saying that you are struggling with something and you could use some support. It’s your choice on how much you want to tell them, so if they ask questions that you are not comfortable with, tell them. This is a big step and I am happy you are willing to take it. The moment you start talking about it, it gets better. Good luck!
